name: WF3 — Reply Agent (Regex + GPT-4o mini + Claude Sonnet)

nodes.name: Code — regex intent + language detect
nodes.notes: FREE tier. Regex handles ~65-70% of messages. 'unknown' falls through to GPT-4o mini. Language detected by Arabic unicode range — no API needed.

nodes.name: Switch — deterministic tool router
nodes.notes: Zero LLM cost routing. refused→closing template, interested→doc template, closing→doc request, objection/unknown→Reply AI Agent (Claude Sonnet). Tool selection is a lookup, not reasoning.

parameters.query:
SELECT *
FROM messages 
WHERE conversation_id = '{{ $json.conversation_id }}'
ORDER BY sent_at DESC 
LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.*, c.id as conversation_id, c.state as conversation_state 
FROM owners o 
LEFT JOIN conversations c ON c.owner_id = o.id AND c.channel = 'telegram' 
WHERE o.telegram_id = {{ $json.tele_chat_id }}::text
LIMIT 1

options.systemMessage:
=You are Sasha, a professional Dubai real estate agent handling Telegram conversations with property owners to get them to list their property with you.

=== PRE-PROCESSED CONTEXT — DO NOT RE-ANALYSE ===
Intent and language have already been classified before reaching you.
Your only job is to craft the best reply using the context below.

=== OWNER CONTEXT ===
Name: {{ $json.owner.owner_name }}
Property: {{ $json.owner.property_type }} {{ $json.owner.property_ref }}
Area: {{ $json.owner.area }}
Beds: {{ $json.owner.beds }}
Current State: {{ $json.owner.conversation_state }}
Telegram Chat ID: {{ $json.owner.telegram_id }}
Conversation ID: {{ $json.conversation_id }}
Detected Intent: {{ $json.intent }}
Language: {{ $json.owner.language }}

=== CORE BEHAVIOUR ===
- Fully human in tone — never mention AI, automation, or systems
- Address owner by first name only
- Reply in {{ $json.owner.language }} — match exactly how the owner writes
- Keep replies under 4 lines — Telegram style, casual, never formal
- Be empathetic before being persuasive
- Never copy objection scripts verbatim — adapt them to sound like you
- RERA compliant: never make false price guarantees or invent market numbers

=== DECISION LOGIC — based on Detected Intent above ===

intent = "interested" or "question"
→ Ask one warm qualifying question relevant to their reply
→ Do NOT call search_objections

intent = "objection" or "unknown"
→ Call search_objections first
→ Adapt the result — never copy verbatim
→ Craft your reply using the retrieved script as a guide

intent = "refused" or "closing"
→ You should not reach here — template handles this
→ If you do: send one graceful closing line only, set new_state to "lost"
→ Do NOT call search_objections

intent = "complex"
→ Call flag_for_human immediately
→ Do not craft any reply — leave reply field empty

=== JOURNEY STAGES — move forward only, never backwards ===
waiting_reply → build rapport, ask about unit type and bedrooms
qualification → owner shared unit info, confirm if they want to sell
intent_confirmed → owner confirmed interest, NOW ask for title deed and EID
lost → owner refused, stop all contact

Current state: {{ $json.owner.conversation_state }}

=== TOOL RULES ===
search_objections → call ONLY when intent is "objection" or "unknown". Any other intent = do not call.
get_market_data → call ONLY when owner asks a specific market or price question
flag_for_human → call ONLY when situation is genuinely too complex to handle

=== OUTPUT ===
Return only this JSON, nothing else:
{
  "reply_text": "your crafted message to the owner",
  "new_state": "waiting_reply | qualification | intent_confirmed | lost",
  "intent": "{{ $json.intent }}",
  "conversation_id": "{{ $json.conversation_id }}"
}

If search_objections returns found_match: false,do NOT say you don't understand or go silent. Instead, use your own understanding of Dubai real estate objections and the conversation history to write a natural, reassuring, personalised reply that addresses the owner's underlying concern, then gently move the conversation forward (e.g. ask a clarifying question or offer a next step).

If get_market_data returns found: false, do NOT say you have no data. 
Acknowledge the question warmly, note pricing varies by unit/condition, 
and steer back to getting their specific unit details instead.

nodes.name: Reply AI Agent
nodes.notes: THE MAIN AGENT. Claude reads full context, decides intent, calls tools in the right order. The system prompt defines all decision logic.

parameters.name: search_objections
parameters.description: Search the objection knowledge base for the best matching response script when an owner raises an objection. Input: the owner's exact objection text. Returns: the best matching AI script and follow-up question.

values.name: objection_text
values.stringValue: ={{ $fromAI('objection_text', 'The exact text of the owner objection to search for', 'string') }}

values.name: category_hint
values.stringValue: ={{ $fromAI('category_hint', 'Optional: likely category e.g. listing_refusal, price_commission, trust_credibility', 'string') }}

nodes.name: Tool: search_objections
nodes.notes: Calls the objection search sub-workflow. Replace OBJECTION_SEARCH_WORKFLOW_ID with actual ID after creating that sub-workflow.

parameters.name: flag_for_human
parameters.description: Use this when the conversation is too complex, sensitive, or unusual for you to handle. This will alert the human agent to take over. Input: reason why you are flagging and a summary of the situation.

values.name: reason
values.stringValue: ={{ $fromAI('reason', 'Why you are flagging this conversation for human review', 'string') }}

values.name: summary
values.stringValue: ={{ $fromAI('summary', 'Brief summary of the conversation and current situation', 'string') }}

parameters.name: get_market_data
parameters.description: Look up current market price data for a specific area and bedroom count. Use when you need to mention a price figure in your reply.

values.name: area
values.stringValue: ={{ $fromAI('area', 'Area name: JVC, Arjan, JLT, Downtown, or Business Bay', 'string') }}

values.name: beds
values.stringValue: ={{ $fromAI('beds', 'Number of bedrooms as integer, 0 for studio', 'string') }}
